bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money for the Slow the Spread program to manage spongy moth populations.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SPONGY MOTH MANAGEMENT. +]

[+$954,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $954,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the environment and natural resources trust fund to the commissioner of agriculture for the Slow the Spread program for monitoring, control, and treatment of spongy moth populations. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money for the Slow the Spread program to manage spongy moth populations.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SPONGY MOTH MANAGEMENT.

$954,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $954,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the environment and natural resources trust fund to the commissioner of agriculture for the Slow the Spread program for monitoring, control, and treatment of spongy moth populations.
additions: $954,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $954,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the environment and natural resources trust fund to the commissioner of agriculture for the Slow the Spread program for monitoring, control, and treatment of spongy moth populations.
